author: Retro Game Corps
description:
Even though we have a ton of GBA-like handheld options, the new KONKR Pocket Advance somehow pushes things a step further, thanks to its elevated design and comfort. And thankfully, the overall experience is good enough to allow me to overlook its soft and mushy controls.
